description: This file contains common utility functions for web UI interactions, including logout, loading indicators, wireless restart checks, string handling, user checks, URL query parsing, language and timezone detection, and REST API handlers.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to a specified URL or default pre_out.html.

methods.name: loading_wait_300s
methods.description: Displays a loading message with a progress percentage updating every 3 seconds for 300 seconds.

methods.name: loading_wait_control
methods.description: Displays a loading message with a progress percentage over a specified wait time, then executes a callback.

methods.name: get_status_success_cb
methods.description: Callback to handle successful wireless status check, updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: get_status_error_cb
methods.description: Callback to handle errors during wireless status check, retries status check unless unauthorized.

methods.name: check_wireless_restart_status
methods.description: Increments wireless process percentage, updates UI, and queries wireless status via API.

methods.name: loading_wait_wireless_restart
methods.description: Initiates wireless restart wait process, periodically checking status.

methods.name: string_display_handler
methods.description: Sanitizes a string for HTML display by replacing < and > characters.

methods.name: check_local_user
methods.description: Checks if a login IP is within a specified subnet based on IP and mask.

methods.name: reboot_back_checker
methods.description: Periodically checks if a server has rebooted by pinging a URL, then logs out.

methods.name: queryString
methods.description: Parses URL query parameters into an object.

methods.name: get_browser_lang
methods.description: Detects the browser's language and returns a language code.

methods.name: get_browser_timezone
methods.description: Returns the browser's timezone offset in hours.

methods.name: get_target_page
methods.description: Extracts and constructs a target page path from URL parameters.

methods.name: get_target_tab
methods.description: Retrieves the 't' parameter from URL query string.

methods.name: REST_API_GET
methods.description: Performs an AJAX GET request with event listeners.

methods.name: REST_API_POST
methods.description: Performs an AJAX POST request with callback handlers.
